column1: # INV-T-4911. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-371, 701, 362, 858, 1303, 772,
# 2444, 658 (read from Keel), plus the identifiers pinned by INV-Q-5189 for the done-when (rows under the requirement
# that pins them: INV-REQ-370, 374, 493, 658, 771, 777, 1166). One row per identifier, under the first requirement that names it.
# Not rows, because they are not rules contract identifiers:
#   services and modules: rules-svc, payload-svc, tenancy-svc, reconciliation-svc, notification-svc, canonical-svc, evidence-svc, product-runtime, PackSource, gst-catalogue;
#   events: PackReadinessAcknowledged, RulePackStaged, CanonicalVersionCreated (rules/asyncapi.yaml or other services' contracts);

#   snake_case names of rows (API-09): effective_from, effective_to (rows effectiveFrom, effectiveTo), transaction_date (the pack-resolution date, request property transactionDate), doc_uuid, pack_type;
#   IRAS category codes, scenario-pack data: NA, TXNA, DS, OS, SRRC, TX, ZR, BL;
#   catalogue words of other requirements: MANUAL, AUTO_RELEASE, AUTO_RETRY, INFO, OVERRIDABLE, TERMINAL, AREA-NNN;
#   line fields of the canonical and ingestion contracts: inputTaxClaimed, taxAmount;
#   operations of other services' contracts: goLive, bulkResolve, replaySubmissions, withdrawConsent, deleteAtRetentionEnd;
#   armPack (INV-REQ-1166, 962): the rules contract's existing operationId is armRegulatoryPack, unchanged by this task.

#   INV-T-6327 (INV-REQ-1033, 648, INV-AC-1858): roles tax.operator, entity.admin; event EvidenceArtefactRecorded (service-runtime's event); none is an element of the Scenario pack rendition wording schema.

#   INV-T-6456 (INV-REQ-480, 486): the backticked names C5UID, cac:AdditionalDocumentReference, cac:ContractDocumentReference, sgdtotal-excl-gst, sgdtotal-incl-gst are pack content of the later seed-content task, not elements of the MDE pack contents schema.
# Enum members shared by several properties (CLAIMABLE_PORTION, ENTIRE_INVOICE, BILL_FOR_PAYMENT ...) are one row each.
